name: vortos/vortos-sse
description: Vortos Server-Sent Events — realtime change nudges to browsers over a Mercure hub, with a Redis-backed signal and bounded in-PHP stream as the hub-less fallback

suggest.ext-redis: Required by RedisRealtimeSignal for cross-process realtime signalling
suggest.ext-curl: Required by CurlHubPublisher to publish to the Mercure hub; without it only the in-process stream fallback is available
